title: TokenAggregateByClient
description: Per-client variant of token-aggregate.schema.json. Same rolling token totals over a time window, additionally keyed by clientId so the workspace timeline can render per-client legends in addition to per-project ones. Stored alongside the project-keyed aggregates under logs/tokens/by-client/<clientId>.jsonl. The Task Access Layer is the single writer; every mutation that records token usage carries the originating clientId.

clientId.description: References client-identity.id. The aggregator never invents this; the API rejects token-recording mutations from unregistered clients before they reach this writer.

project.description: Project name (same value used in the project-keyed aggregate).

windowStart.description: Inclusive UTC start of the aggregation window.

windowEnd.description: Exclusive UTC end of the aggregation window.

cli.description: Which CLI produced the tokens. Aggregates are kept per CLI because pricing and budget windows differ.

model.description: Concrete model id used during the window, e.g. claude-opus-4-7.

dollars.description: Optional dollar estimate for the window when pricing is known. Null when only token counts are available.

jobIds.description: Job ids whose runs contributed to this window, ordered chronologically.

jobsCompleted.description: How many jobs reached 4-review or 5-completed during the window.
